doorbell.title: Eufy Doorbell
install.body: The listener runs on eufy-sdk, an unofficial community library. Installing downloads it from npm into ~/.local/share/omarchy-eufy-doorbell.
install.busy: Installing eufy-sdk. This takes a minute.
install.failed: The install failed. The shell log has the details.
node.body: The listener needs Node.js 24.5 or newer on your PATH, for example through: mise use -g node@lts
account.heading: Use a second eufy account
account.why: eufy allows one login per account at a time. On your own account, the app on your phone and Omarchy would keep logging each other out. Give Omarchy an account of its own; it takes about five minutes.
account.step1.title: Create a second eufy account
account.step1.body: eufy accounts are made in the Anker eufy app. Log out of your own account there (or use another phone or tablet), tap Sign up at the bottom right, and choose the same region as your own account. Use another email address: an alias such as you+doorbell@… works if your mail provider supports it. Confirm with the code from the activation email; it can take 15 minutes, so check your spam folder.
account.step1.link: eufy help: sign up for an account
account.step2.title: Share the doorbell with it
account.step2.body: Log back in to the app as yourself and go to the home page › your avatar › Share Devices › Invite › Admin. Select the doorbell, and its HomeBase if it has one, and enter the new email address. Older app versions have this under Family & Guests in the side menu.
account.step3.title: Accept the invitation
account.step3.body: Log in to the app once as the new account and accept the invitation; pull down to refresh when it does not show. Check that notifications for the doorbell are on there, because Omarchy hears the same notifications. Then log back in as yourself.
account.step4.title: Log in here
account.step4.body: Fill in the new account's email and password below, and the two letters of the region you chose in step 1, such as NL. eufy then emails you a verification code.
form.countryHint: Two letters: the region from step 1, such as NL
form.secret: The password goes to your keyring, the session to ~/.local/share/omarchy-eufy-doorbell.
captcha.body: eufy wants to know you are human. Type the characters in the picture.
captcha.retry: That was not it. Try this one.
twofa.body: eufy sent a verification code to %1.
error.body: The connection to eufy dropped. It retries by itself.
ready.heading: Doorbells
ready.none: This account sees no doorbell yet. Share the doorbell with it in the eufy app, then try again.
